values: 安丹德拉降低即将受到的伤害，一段时间后用盾眩晕周围敌人，随后用矛击倒周围敌人并造成伤害，同时恢复自身生命值。
Reduces incoming damage, stuns surrounding enemies with her shield after a while, and strikes down the enemies with her spear to deal damage and heal herself.
安丹德拉架起盾牌，嘲讽周围2格的敌人1秒，使自身受到的伤害降低60%并处于霸体状态，持续5秒。随后高举盾牌眩晕周围1格的敌人2秒，并挥舞长矛击倒周围1格的敌人并造成400% ATK伤害，同时恢复自身20% + 5% HP的生命值，每命中一名敌人额外恢复8% + 2% HP的生命值。

Antandra sets her shield up and taunts enemies within 2 tiles for 1s, reducing her damage taken by 60% and becoming unaffected for 5s. Afterward, she raises the shield to stun adjacent enemies for 2s and swings the spear, dealing 400% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them down, recovering 20% + 5% HP HP. Each enemy hit recovers her an extra 8% + 2% HP HP.
选择友军作为“守护对象”。为自己和“守护对象”添加护盾。
Selects an ally to guard, granting them and herself shields.
战斗开始时，安丹德拉选择除自己以外最靠前的友军作为“守护对象”。使用该技能时，安丹德拉为自己和“守护对象”添加能抵御相当于“守护对象”最大生命值15% + 5%伤害的护盾，持续5秒，护盾值最高不超过自身500%攻击力。若“守护对象”被击败，则会重新选择除自己以外最靠前的友方作为“守护对象”。

Antandra selects the frontmost ally (except herself) as the guarded ally when a battle starts. Antandra grants herself and the guarded ally shields that block damage equal to 15% + 5% of the ally's max HP for 5s, and the shield value is up to 500% of her ATK. Antandra reselects another front-most ally (except herself) as the guarded ally if the previous one is defeated.
“守护对象”每失去10%的生命值，减少该技能3秒剩余冷却时间。
Reduces the skill cooldown by 3s whenever the guarded ally loses 10% max HP.
护盾抵御值上升至“守护对象”最大生命值的20% + 5%。
Increases the shield value to 20% + 5% of the guarded ally's max HP.
护盾抵御值上升至“守护对象”最大生命值的25% + 5%。
Increases the shield value to 25% + 5% of the guarded ally's max HP.
连续攻击前方3次，降低目标攻击力。
Attacks a frontal area 3 times, reducing the targets' ATK.
安丹德拉连续攻击前方1格扇形区域3次并降低目标20%攻击力，持续6 + 1秒，前2次攻击造成100% ATK伤害，第3次攻击造成120%伤害。
Antandra attacks the frontal area within a 1-tile arc 3 times and reduces the targets' ATK by 20% for 6 + 1s, with the first 2 hits dealing 100% ATK damage and the third hit dealing 120% damage.
第3次攻击伤害提升至140% ATK。
Increases the damage of 3rd attack to 140% ATK.
第3次攻击伤害提升至160% ATK。
Increases the damage of 3rd attack to 160% ATK.
第3次攻击伤害提升至180% ATK。
Increases the damage of 3rd attack to 180% ATK.
战斗中，自身的最大生命值提升17%。
Increases max HP by 17% during battle.
战斗中，自身的最大生命值提升23%。
Increases max HP by 23% during battle.
战斗中，自身的最大生命值提升29%。
Increases max HP by 29% during battle.
冲向“守护对象”，使其受到的伤害降低。
Rushes next to the guarded ally to grant them damage reduction.
“守护对象”的生命值比例首次低于50%时，安丹德拉会冲向“守护对象”身边，使“守护对象”受到的伤害降低40%，持续10秒。该技能在一场战斗内对每个“守护对象”至多使用一次。

Antandra rushes next to the guarded ally when their HP ratio drops below 50% for the first time, reducing their damage taken by 40% for 10s. This skill can only be used once for each guarded ally per battle.
安丹德拉冲向“守护对象”身边后，还会使“守护对象”每秒恢复100点能量，持续4秒。
Rushes next to the guarded ally, recovering their Energy by 100 per second for 4s.
安丹德拉冲向“守护对象”身边后，“守护对象”受到的伤害降低50%。
Rushes next to the guarded ally, reducing their damage taken by 50%.
安丹德拉冲向“守护对象”身边后，“守护对象”受到的伤害降低60%。
Rushes next to the guarded ally, reducing their damage taken by 60%.
技能“盾墙突击”命中敌人时永久提升自己护甲。
Antandra increases her Phys DEF when Shield Assault hits the enemy.
技能“盾墙突击”每命中一名敌人永久提升自己10%的护甲，最多叠加6次。
Each enemy hit by Shield Assault increases 10% of Antandra's Phys DEF, up to 6 stacks.
技能“盾阵固守”为“守护对象”添加的护盾值提升，提升量相当于安丹德拉40%的当前生命值。此外，“守护对象”在拥有该护盾期间造成伤害时会为安丹德拉回复生命值，回复量等同于伤害量的60%。

Antandra increases the shield value her guarded ally receives from Shield Formation by 40% of her current HP. While the shield is active, the guarded ally also heals Antandra for 60% of the damage they deal.
